description: 生命支持系统bug，压缩气体释放后温度降至-273°C并降低压力
evidence: Buggy Life support: compressing gas from a room into a can and than releasing it again magically cools it to -273°C for some reason which in turn reduces its pressure.. making it increadibly hard for heaters to heat it up again...
